title: Stonebridge Arena crowd surge runbook
brief: I'm the safety officer at Stonebridge Arena and I need a runbook for a crowd surge at the gates on event days, to be laminated and kept in the control room, where the duty team reads it on a wall screen and on paper. Dated 2026-10-27, for the arena of 18000 seats. Under "When to use this": use it when the queue at any gate passes 1500 people, or when stewards report density above 4 people per square meter anywhere outside the gates. Under "Steps" in order, with who and by when counted from the call: 1, the control room supervisor Rana Idris declares a surge on the radio, immediately; 2, the announcer reads the queue message, within 2 minutes; 3, gate stewards under Pieter Haas open overflow gates B and C, within 4 minutes; 4, Rana calls the police liaison, within 5 minutes; 5, the medical lead Dr. Sunita Bhatt stages two teams near the gates, within 6 minutes; 6, the transport desk asks the tram operator to hold arrivals for 10 minutes, within 8 minutes. Under "Thresholds" as a table: amber, 4 people per square meter or a queue over 1500; red, 5 people per square meter, stop entry at that gate and keep the exits clear. Under "Contacts": radio channel 3 for stewards, channel 5 for medical, police liaison on 0800 555 0163. Put the red threshold in a highlighted warning.

edit.request: Move the amber queue threshold from 1500 to 1200 people, and change the tram hold from 10 minutes to 15 minutes.
